publications.paper_id: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Paper-I Series 'B'..pdf
publications.explanation:
Canada is the historical answer. Statistics Canada’s release of 22 March 2023 reported population growth of 2.7% during 2022, with international migration accounting for 95.9% of that growth. It said that keeping that growth rate constant would imply doubling in about 26 years. This was a conditional illustration, rather than a guarantee that Canada’s population would double on a fixed date. [Original release](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/230322/dq230322f-eng.htm).

Update — checked 11 November 2026: a release dated 23 September 2026 estimates Canada’s population at 41,798,407 on 1 July 2026, up 0.2% during the second quarter. These preliminary figures may be revised. The quarterly rate describes a different period from the original annual rate and should not be substituted into the old question. [Dated 2026 estimates](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/260923/dq260923b-eng.htm).

after.paperId: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Paper-II Series 'B'.pdf
after.question: A cube has six different symbols drawn over its six faces. The symbols are dot, circle, triangle, square, cross and arrow. Three different positions of the cube are shown in figures X,Y, and Z. Which symbol is opposite the dot?
after.explanation: The cross is opposite the dot. In view Y, the cross touches the square and the triangle. In view Z, it touches the arrow and the circle. That accounts for all four faces adjacent to the cross. A cube face has four neighbours and one opposite face; the only remaining symbol is the dot. Therefore the cross and dot must be on opposite faces. This method uses adjacency across the views, so there is no need to guess a rotation from the direction of the arrow.
